title: Back-to-School Pack Sweepstakes Giveaway August 2024
body:
See full terms and conditions in the Master Sweepstakes Rules here: https://support.discord.com/hc/articles/16000885744791-Master-Sweepstakes-Rules 

By entering, you agree to these Master Sweepstakes Terms.

  • Eligibility Requirements: You must be a legal resident of the United States and thirteen (13) years of age or older (with legal guardian approval if you are under the age of majority) as of the date of entry.
  • Entry Time Frame: Tuesday, August 6, 2024 (10:00 AM PST) - Friday, August 9th, 2024 (5:00 PM PST)
  • TikTok Giveaway:
    • How to Enter: Comment on the giveaway post on Discord’s official TikTok with your favorite school subject with the hashtag #DiscordBack2School.
    • Prizes: One (1) Prize Winner will receive ($275 Total Value): 
      • One (1) Discord Reimagined Backpack ($150) 
      • One (1) Guardian’s Guide printed brochure ($3) 
      • One (1) month of Nitro, on us ($10) 
      • One (1) Teen Charter branded pickleball paddle ($87) 
      • One (1) Safety Tarot card pack ($25)
  • Instagram Giveaway:
    • How to Enter: Comment on the giveaway post on Discord’s official Instagram with your favorite school subject with the hashtag #DiscordBack2School.
    • Prizes: One (1) Prize Winner will receive ($275 Total Value): 
      • One (1) Discord Reimagined Backpack ($150) 
      • One (1) Guardian’s Guide printed brochure ($3) 
      • One (1) month of Nitro, on us ($10) 
      • One (1) Teen Charter branded pickleball paddle ($87) 
      • One (1) Safety Tarot card pack ($25)
  • Twitter / X Giveaway: 
    • How to Enter: Reply to the giveaway post on X with your favorite school subject with the hashtag #DiscordBack2School.
    • Prizes: One (1) Prize Winner will receive ($275 Total Value): 
      • One (1) Discord Reimagined Backpack ($150) 
      • One (1) Guardian’s Guide printed brochure ($3) 
      • One (1) month of free Nitro ($10) 
      • One (1) Teen Charter branded pickleball paddle ($87) 
      • One (1) Safety Tarot card pack ($25)
  • Winner Notification Date: By Tuesday August 13, 2024 (5:00 PM PT)

Notification Method: Winners will be notified via DM through the account they used to enter the Giveaway and have one (1) week to respond in order to claim their prize.
